description: This file contains SQL store methods for managing categories in the Focalboard server, including CRUD operations, reordering, and fetching categories for users and teams.

methods.name: categoryFields
methods.description: Returns the list of database fields for categories.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Fetches a category by ID from the database.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category and updates the sort order of existing categories.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates the name, update timestamp, and collapsed state of a category.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Marks a category as deleted by setting delete_at timestamp.

methods.name: getUserCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories for a specific user and team.

methods.name: categoriesFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of Category models.

methods.name: reorderCategories
methods.description: Reorders categories based on a new order of IDs.
